about: How heat is reported: 101 unique records from 103 publication records in two collections. Pilot codes are provisional (coded once, without a second coding). Fields a source does not record are null. CC BY 4.0 for Common Shade's own fields; titles and articles belong to their publishers.

collection.label: Curated collection
collection.method: Gathered in October 2026 by searching for prominent English-language reporting on heat in South and Southeast Asia. The searches captured more of 2024's prominent reporting, and some countries not at all.

pilot.label: Multilingual pilot review
pilot.method: Found in October 2026 by searching for reporting on work and protection in the countries and languages the collection missed, then read one by one. Chosen to see what such reporting can look like, not how common it is.

listing.label: Headline and listing
listing.note: Headline, outlet, year, place and a short story angle written by the curator. The full text was not coded; patterns drawn from it rest on headlines, descriptions and some full texts not recorded one by one.

full.label: Full text, provisional coding
full.note: The full article was opened and read, and coded once, without a second coding. Every code cites the passage it rests on. Treat the codes as provisional until reviewed.

trail_states.not_found: Not found in the reviewed material

link_check.note: Opened means the page answered an automated request; its content was not re-read.
